scope: Isolated Web acceptance on port 3266 with the production Rust Host and Schedule backend on WZU_Server. The installed macOS XHarness was not changed.

implementation.backend: automation/manage delegates to the existing runtime Schedule service; no new model tool or scheduler.
implementation.stateSemantics: Historical tool receipt is separate from live schedule state and last run state. Controls require verified backend state.
implementation.transport: Existing Connection RPC; session isolation, bounded reads/mutations, no automatic mutation retry, lifecycle cleanup and hidden-page suspension.
implementation.rawJson: Folded into Details; malformed and domain failures remain inspectable.

regression.finalRustChange: Avoid publishing full history for read-only card queries. All 5 card backend tests and the Host build passed after this change; four edited Rust files matched remote hashes.
regression.uiBuild: Strict TypeScript and deterministic build verification passed.
regression.architecture: 38 crate boundaries and 8 extracted processors passed.
regression.scopeTests: Cross-session/missing/deleted/archived ownership checks; unmount and late responses; hidden-page reads; duplicate clicks; mutation timeout.

realModel.costMethod: Peak price upper estimate, no cached/off-peak discounts; not account balance delta.
realModel.cardActions: Create displayed; pause, resume and second pause persisted through backend. Delete opened confirmation and was cancelled, not deleted. Card commands made no model request.
realModel.scopeSwitch: Switched to the other fixture session then back; no foreign card appeared. Final paused state loaded from the backend.
realModel.locale: Chinese labels and date verified in the isolated page.
realModel.fixtureCorrection: An unsupported token-count POST returned 404 without consuming the body over keep-alive, producing an HTTP parse error on the next request. Fixed the temporary budget broker to close that response connection. This failure made no paid request and is not a production Harness defect.
